summary: Patch escapes single quotes in the password and wraps it in Pattern.quote() inside PasswordObfuscator.obfuscate(String, RoleOptions), plus a CHANGES.txt entry and a rewritten PasswordObfuscatorTest. Applied the absence.md and completeness.md checklists. Checked the callers (CreateRoleStatement and AlterRoleStatement use the RoleOptions overload; AuditLogManager and QueryEvents use the single-argument overload, which is unchanged), the sibling regex and escaping sites in cql3 and auth, and the CHANGES.txt placement. No missing counterpart, unhandled call site, stale comment or dead parameter was found. Not reviewed: nothing in the diff. The test file was not examined in depth since its assertions belong to the tests lens.
